about: Every sound the mashup plays. game=roblox: read from the player's own Roblox install (content/sounds/<file>) at runtime, decoded in memory. game=minecraft: a vanilla sound event. game=mod: the mod's own sound (made from scratch by fabric/tools/audio/make_audio.py; an event in the mod's assets sounds.json; volume over 1 carries it further, it's no louder). Fortnite audio comes only from its unencrypted movies (media sheet).

rows.use: a player or bot is eliminated
any avatar jumps
any avatar lands from a jump
footsteps in the hub and on the obby
respawn at an obby checkpoint
falling off the obby or skydiving
emote menu clicks, checkpoint reached
assault rifle shot (its own sound; every rarity sounds the same)
pump shotgun shot and the pump racked after it
SMG shot
pistol shot
rocket launcher: the thump out of the tube and the motor's whoosh (v2.0.0)
a rocket or grenade exploding (heard far off)
a thrown grenade knocking on the ground
sniper shot, its crack echoing away (heard furthest)
trigger pulled with no ammo
reloading
bandages / med kit while used: a bandage wrapping round, cloth rustling (2.0.0-test4; was Minecraft's eating)
shields, Chug Jug and Slurp Juice while drunk: a gulp that fizzes and shimmers (2.0.0-test4; was Minecraft's drinking)
a heal finished, health going up: two warm notes rising (2.0.0-test4)
a Victory Royale: a rising brass call and a held chord over a drum roll, for the winners (2.0.0-test5)
a shield finished, the shield charging: a rising whoosh and a bright shimmer (2.0.0-test4)
plays once each time the storm starts shrinking: rising wind, an uneasy tone and falling chimes (no storm music)
your shot hit someone
your shot hit someone in the head (instead of hit_marker)
glider deploys during the drop
loot chest opened
you or a teammate were knocked down
a knocked teammate is back on their feet
you picked up a teammate's reboot card
a reboot van brought teammates back
a car door swinging open as someone gets in or out (2.0.0-test3)
the car door shutting behind them (2.0.0-test3)
a car's boost kicking in (2.0.0-test3; its engine and tyres are CarSounds' loops, car.engine and car.skid)
